items.subject: Standalone core versus ORUDA required preflight
items.resolution: Core profile must not require ORUDA; ORUDA becomes an explicit optional profile.

items.subject: Three incompatible state models
items.resolution: Keep product lifecycle, validation run and assurance publication state machines separate and map them explicitly.

items.subject: Product implementation complete claim versus official status
items.resolution: Replace completion claim with validator-slice status and current source-bound evidence status.

items.subject: Product E2E naming versus executed fixture scope
items.resolution: Treat current run as validator fixture E2E; reserve product Full-Chain for VS Code, runtime, patch, Git and restore flow.

items.subject: AI behavior validation name versus marker scan implementation
items.resolution: Rename the existing stage to policy marker scan or implement actual repeated agent/model/tool execution.

items.subject: RCA completion versus template-only inference
items.resolution: Template output must be RCA_CANDIDATE until reproduction, first-failure and causal evidence are bound.

items.subject: Git SHA and artifact SHA validation
items.resolution: Use 40 or 64 hex for Git object identity and exactly 64 hex for SHA-256 artifact digests.

items.subject: README links versus actual document names
items.resolution: Replace broken links with current authoritative files.
